title: UFC Round Statistics
description:
Round-by-round striking and grappling statistics from the UFC — one row per fighter per round, with bout and event context joined on.

Generated from the Cito UFC API (https://citoapi.com/ufc-api/). The upstream API returns strikes as combined strings ("3 of 5") and control time as a clock ("0:11"); this dataset splits those into clean integer columns and adds derived accuracy fields, so it loads straight into pandas with no parsing work.

FILES
- round_stats.csv      One row per fighter per round. ~2,300 rows across ~500 bouts and ~620 fighters.
- dwcs_prospects.csv   Every Dana White's Contender Series bout on the current season, with both fighters' profiles attached.
- generate.py          Regenerates both files from the live API.

COLUMNS (round_stats)
Identity: event_slug, event_title, event_date, bout_id, weight_class, is_title_bout, card_section, fighter_slug, fighter_name, opponent_slug, opponent_name
Result:   result, result_round, result_time, winner_slug
Round:    round, knockdowns, submission_attempts, reversals, control_time_sec
Strikes:  sig_strikes_landed, sig_strikes_attempted, sig_strike_accuracy, total_strikes_landed, total_strikes_attempted
Grappling: takedowns_landed, takedowns_attempted, takedown_accuracy
Target splits:   head_landed/attempted, body_landed/attempted, leg_landed/attempted
Position splits: distance_landed/attempted, clinch_landed/attempted, ground_landed/attempted

EXAMPLE QUESTIONS
- Which fighters land the most significant strikes per round?
- How does striking accuracy vary by weight class?
- Does control time predict winning a round?
- Which fighters are most effective at distance versus in the clinch?

LIMITATIONS
- dwcs_prospects is sparse: Contender Series fighters are not yet on the main roster, so country, division, age and stance are frequently null. Record and reach are reliable.
- opponent_name is null for ~2% of rows where the corner could not be matched.
- Accuracy fields are null when attempts were zero, to avoid divide-by-zero.
- Coverage reflects recent events, not the full historical catalogue. Increase the sweep with --events N in generate.py.

REGENERATE
  pip install httpx
  export CITO_API_KEY=your-key    # free tier: https://citoapi.com/signup/
  python generate.py --dataset all --events 40
